bosses.name: Gohma
bosses.hint: The parasite inside the Deku Tree. Stun it when its eye opens, then strike.

bosses.name: King Dodongo
bosses.hint: The giant lizard king. Toss bombs into its mouth when it opens wide, then hit it while it rolls.

bosses.name: Barinade
bosses.hint: The electric jellyfish. Cut its tentacles with the boomerang, then hit its body.

bosses.name: Phantom Ganon
bosses.hint: The ghostly rider. Return his energy balls with your sword, then strike the real one when he appears.

bosses.name: Volvagia
bosses.hint: The fire dragon. Smash it with the Megaton Hammer when it comes out of the lava.

bosses.name: Morpha
bosses.hint: The water amoeba. Hookshot its core out of the water and strike it.

bosses.name: Bongo Bongo
bosses.hint: The shadow beast. Use the Lens of Truth to see it, shoot its hands, then strike its eye.

bosses.name: Twinrova
bosses.hint: The twin witches. Absorb one sister's magic with the Mirror Shield and fire it back at the other.

bosses.name: Ganondorf
bosses.hint: The final duel. Return his energy balls, strike him down, then finish the beast form with the Master Sword and Light Arrows.

trials.title: Boss trial I
trials.hint: Start a boss gauntlet from a Kaepora Gaebora statue in the center of the Hall. Clear the bosses back to back to earn a trophy for Link's bedroom.

trials.title: Boss trial II
trials.hint: A second boss gauntlet from the center statues. Chain the rematches without stopping to add another trophy.

trials.title: Boss trial III
trials.hint: A third boss gauntlet from the center statues. The hardest run of the Hall — finish it for the final trophy.
